cues: Why does a current heat a wire?
The electric field speeds the electrons up, but they keep crashing into the vibrating ions of the lattice, handing over the energy they gained.
The ions jiggle harder, and that is heat.
The drift speed stays steady, so all the electrical energy turns into heat.
